title: Totally Minted – Eucalyptus Minted 100ML
description:
Totally Minted – Eucalyptus Minted 100ML
Totally Minted – The freshest, coldest most MINTED juice to light up your taste buds and keep the summer heat at bay.
A delightful combination of arctic coolness and eucalyptus minted flavour.
Totally Minted E-Liquids come at 0MG Nicotine and have 70VG/30PG ratio. It is not to be missed if you love mint flavoured e juices.
